title: light brazilian sweet-rice-flour gratin
description: a pescatarian-friendly, light brazilian dish featuring sweet rice flour chapssalgaru with a cheesy gratin topping.
instructions: preheat the oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit.
in a large mixing bowl, combine the sweet rice flour, egg, yogurt, parmesan cheese, butter, ginger, lemon zest, salt, and pepper. mix until a dough forms.
knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
divide the dough into 6 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
heat 1/4 cup of cooking oil in a large skillet over medium heat. add the shrimp and cook until pink, about 2-3 minutes per side.
add the scallions to the skillet and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes until softened.
add the cooked shrimp and scallions to the dough balls and mix until well combined.
transfer the dough balls to a baking dish lined with parchment paper.
bake the gratin in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes until the top is golden brown and the dough is cooked through.
remove the gratin from the oven and let it cool for 5-10 minutes before serving.
